"Make a complete Brotato-style game for mobile: a top-down arena
survivor roguelite. Single HTML5 file (Canvas/JS), touch controls,
60 FPS. Finish it fully and playable, with no placeholders.

CONTROLS
- Virtual joystick on the left side of the screen to move.
- Weapons auto-aim and auto-fire at the nearest enemy.

GAME LOOP
- 10 waves, 30 seconds each. Enemies spawn continuously and get
  harder every wave.
- Enemies drop coins. Walk over them to collect.
- After each wave, open a shop with 4 items, a reroll button
  (price goes up each use), and a lock option.
- Leveling up lets me pick 1 of 3 random stat upgrades.
- Die = game over screen with stats and a retry button.
  Survive wave 10 = victory.

CONTENT
- 5 weapons: pistol, shotgun, SMG, sword, flamethrower.
  Buying a duplicate upgrades it.
- 5 enemy types: chaser, fast, tank, shooter, exploder.
  Boss on wave 10.
- 15 shop items with trade-offs (e.g. +damage, -max HP).
- 3 characters with different bonuses.
- Stats: HP, regen, damage, attack speed, crit, armor, speed,
  luck, pickup range.

POLISH
- Damage numbers, hit flash, screen shake, particles.
- Simple colorful cartoon shapes, a consistent style.
- Sound effects and a menu, pause, and mute button.
- Save best wave and unlocks in localStorage.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile-first Brotato-style arena survivor roguelite as a single HTML5 Canvas/JS file.

## Requirements
- 10 waves, 30 seconds each; escalating enemies, coins, shop, rerolls and lock, level-up picks, game over/retry, and victory.
- Virtual joystick and nearest-enemy auto-aim/auto-fire; five weapons and five enemy types including a wave 10 boss.
- 15 trade-off shop items, three characters, requested combat stats, visual effects, sounds, menu/pause/mute, and localStorage best-wave/unlocks.
- Finish fully playable; save small JPEG screenshots for checks.

## Decisions
- Implemented the game self-contained in `index.html`, with inline CSS/JavaScript and no external assets or dependencies.
- Added a dash action as an extra mobile/keyboard control; keyboard movement uses WASD/arrow keys.

## Work State

1. Continue browser testing through wave transition, shop purchases/reroll/lock, level-up selection, and wave 10 boss/victory.
2. Fix any issues found and recheck console output.

- `index.html`: Complete game implementation.

- `starbyte-game.jpg`: Saved mobile gameplay screenshot.

- Changes are uncommitted.

- Build a complete, playable mobile-first Brotato-style arena survivor roguelite as a single HTML5 Canvas/JS file.

## Requirements
- 10 waves, 30 seconds each; escalating enemies, coins, shop, rerolls and lock, level-up picks, game over/retry, and victory.

- Finish fully playable; save small JPEG screenshots for checks.

- Added a dash action as an extra mobile/keyboard control; keyboard movement uses WASD/arrow keys.

## Objective
- Improve the existing self-contained STARBYTE arena-survivor game while preserving its playable features and mobile performance.

## Requirements
- Add a glowing white player outline and visible equipped weapon; distinguish gold coins from bullets and XP gems.
- Shrink the HUD, move combat stats into pause, and show a prominent centered wave timer with an XP bar beneath HP.
- Make the right touch control a dash with cooldown ring and brief invulnerability.
- Add knockback, hit flashes, bullet trails, damage numbers, and coin pop effects.
- Give chaser, fast, tank, shooter, and exploder enemies distinct shapes/colors; include a wave 10 boss health bar.
- Add an arena border and background decoration, plus screen-shake and volume settings.
- Fix bugs and aim to maintain 60 FPS on mobile.

## Decisions
- Continued implementation in `index.html` using the existing inline Canvas/JavaScript architecture.
- Persist volume and screen-shake preferences in localStorage under `starbyte-settings`.

## Work State
### Completed
- Compressed the HUD, removed the always-visible stat line, centered and enlarged the wave timer, and retained the HP/XP bars.
- Added pause-menu DMG/ARM/SPD stats and a settings menu with volume and screen-shake controls.
- Added dash label/cooldown ring styling and connected its display to dash cooldown state.
- Added player outline/glow, damage flash, and a weapon illustration aimed toward the nearest enemy.
- Added enemy knockback and flash, bullet trails, kill coin text/pop animation, distinct enemy silhouettes, and a screen-space arena border.
- Applied volume scaling to sound effects and made shake respect its setting.
- JavaScript syntax check (`node --check /tmp/opencode/starbyte-check.js`) and `git diff --check` completed without errors.

### Active
- Verify the updated game in a browser, including settings navigation, dash cooldown, combat effects, and mobile layout/performance.

### Blocked
- Browser verification was not performed; no Playwright/Puppeteer package was resolvable through the checked Node module paths.

## Next Move
1. Run browser checks when an available browser harness is accessible; inspect mobile HUD overlap, settings return flow, and dash cooldown behavior.
2. Check any gameplay/runtime regressions and fix issues found.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game implementation and all current changes.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- Existing menu/game JPEG screenshots (`starbyte-menu.jpg`, `starbyte-game.jpg`) predate these latest UI and gameplay changes.

- Improve the existing self-contained STARBYTE arena-survivor game while preserving its playable features and mobile performance.

- Add a glowing white player outline and visible equipped weapon; distinguish gold coins from bullets and XP gems.
